failure_checkpoint_checks: Allowlist is grounded in outer verified release-source identity plus metadata-only frozen source/protocol rederivation, registered task IDs and canonical manifest-bound service paths.
Only fixed public metadata/world records, hash-bound service files and frozen source members are copied. No recursive traversal, native database, simulation key, WAL or proof sidecars are selected.
Contained nonsymlink regular files with link count one, stable reads and bounded member/total sizes are required; archive privacy/path/CRC checks precede promotion.

Captured files are individually hash-bound and expressly UNQUALIFIED_FAILURE_CHECKPOINT_NOT_RESUME_AUTHORITY; consistent cut is NOT_ATTESTED. No audit, account reopen, business retry or success claim is added.

Original failure is reraised, diagnostic failure is recorded separately, and final self-plus-waited-child kernel CPU measurement includes cleanup. Existing 2400 CPU-second and 900 wall-second actual-release limits are unchanged.
financial_checks: Private helper performs the complete native replay and derived config/summary/journal/order/investment/invoice/receivable checks before sharing any job authority. Public audit still returns its original receipt dictionary.

Adaptive reuse is local to one audit call; no caller-injected jobs, global cache, cross-action acceptance or pre-WAL/post-WAL state reuse was introduced. Nonadaptive schemas retain their prior second loader.

Every manifest job, including unused/rejected and bundled jobs, has input/artifact/receipt bytes freshly rebound; executing-source/manifest checks occur before and after this pass. Accepted authority keyset and cached triples must match fresh data.
Returned artifacts and receipts are newly parsed objects; manifest job metadata is deep-copied. Native mutable cached objects cannot become unbound extra authority.

Initial native config is deep-copied and pinned. Final manifest digest must match that pinned config, and caller config must remain identical; coordinated in-call config/manifest rebinding is rejected.

Account reservation, obligation, cancellation, writer ownership, rejection certificates, partial-work recovery, durable append ambiguity and direct unsafe-history auditor gates remain in their existing paths. finance.py/WAL behavior was not changed by this optimization.
